notes.title: Release coming in just a few hours!
notes.notes:
The Strategic Thinking development team would like to thank all the people who have been involved in producing Penny's Path, as well as our families who have been so supportive and patient throughout. As we've gone from concept to production and, in just a few short hours, release, we have been humbled by the sensitivity and dedication shown by everyone involved.

One way this has occurred that has been a pleasant surprise to us is the exceptional professionalism and helpfulness of the folks at Valve Software. Releasing a game on Steam has been a delightful experience and we are very thankful to Valve for making the Steam Store available to us and other developers, and for their patience as we've stumbled our way through their complex but eminently well-considered system.

And, finally, thank you to those who have expressed interest in playing the game! We hope that our game and its message reaches many people and opens their minds to certain things that are little considered in today's world. As we collectively endeavor to make sense of modernity, the pandemic, and whatever the future may bring, we hope that reflecting on the ancient mysteries, however light their treatment may be in this medium, will bring wisdom and serenity for the times ahead et lux in tenebris lucet.

Strategic Thinking
